headline: Brazil's Alisson Becker thanks Bangladesh for unwavering support
summary: The global superstar and Liverpool goalkeeper acknowledged the country's extraordinary passion for football after Brazil's victory over Japan.
details: Brazil goalkeeper Alisson Becker has expressed his heartfelt gratitude to Bangladeshi fans for their unwavering support during the FIFA World Cup.
Speaking to a Bangladeshi journalist in Houston, the Liverpool star smiled and said, "Nice, Bangladesh! I've seen your videos. Thank you, Bangladesh, for supporting us."
Alisson revealed that he had watched social media clips of the remarkable atmosphere in Bangladesh, where supporters fill streets and public squares to watch matches on giant screens.
The appreciation comes shortly after Argentina's Emiliano Martínez expressed similar admiration for the country's football culture.
Brazil midfielder Casemiro, who was named Player of the Match against Japan, also thanked Bangladeshi fans during his post-match media duties.
Brazil secured their place in the last 16 with a dramatic 2-1 victory over Japan, with a late winner by Gabriel Martinelli.
caption:
From Houston to Dhaka, the passion is felt! 🇧🇷🇧🇩 Brazil's Alisson Becker sends a special message to Bangladeshi fans.

Brazil goalkeeper Alisson Becker has expressed his heartfelt gratitude to Bangladeshi fans for their unwavering support during the FIFA World Cup.

Speaking to a Bangladeshi journalist in Houston, the Liverpool star smiled and said, "Nice, Bangladesh! I've seen your videos. Thank you, Bangladesh, for supporting us."

Alisson revealed that he had watched social media clips of the remarkable atmosphere in Bangladesh, where supporters fill streets and public squares to watch matches on giant screens.

The appreciation comes shortly after Argentina's Emiliano Martínez expressed similar admiration for the country's football culture.

Brazil midfielder Casemiro, who was named Player of the Match against Japan, also thanked Bangladeshi fans during his post-match media duties.

Brazil secured their place in the last 16 with a dramatic 2-1 victory over Japan, with a late winner by Gabriel Martinelli.

headline: Bangladesh speaker to join Khameni’s funeral in Tehran
summary: Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmed will travel to Iran to attend the funeral rites of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.
details: Bangladesh Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmed is traveling to Tehran to participate in the funeral of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.
The Speaker's visit to the Iranian capital is part of a diplomatic gesture to honor the deceased leader.
Additionally, Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif may also attend the funeral services in Tehran.
The event is expected to draw various international dignitaries as the region mourns the loss of the Supreme Leader.
caption:
Bangladesh Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmed is heading to Tehran to attend the funeral of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

Bangladesh Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmed is traveling to Tehran to participate in the funeral of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

The Speaker's visit to the Iranian capital is part of a diplomatic gesture to honor the deceased leader.

Additionally, Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif may also attend the funeral services in Tehran.

The event is expected to draw various international dignitaries as the region mourns the loss of the Supreme Leader.
